text:
Type: rectangular shade floor lamp
Use: ambient light beside a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: white fabric rectangular shade, nickel-plated metal frame and square base
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: boxy rectangular shade on a tall looped stand that splits into two parallel rails curving into a U near the floor, small square base, slim, tall and graphic
Feel: elegant, calm, refined, crisp
Goes with: grey or white upholstery, glass and metal tables, white walls; contemporary or modern living rooms

product.description: As the light can be dimmed, you are able to choose lighting suitable for every occasion.
